protocol.measurement_history: Development dev1-dev4 recorded executed checks only. This version freezes the 58 planned check names and pads not-executed checks; no prior report is relabeled or backfilled.
protocol.truth: Nine manually enumerated groups, 18 source records; exact unit conversion and no fuzzy matching or currency conversion
protocol.variation: Combined versus split whole-field JSON, row order, project aliases, actor names/display names, filenames and source locations
protocol.not_executed: Construction failures preserve traceback and all declared check names; missing executions are failed checks with not_executed=true. Executed and planned denominators are separate; layout comparison is additional.
protocol.scope: Synthetic finite reconciliation, public program strategy, actual immutable files/submissions; no model or training benefit claim

script.method: SHA256 of exact frozen git blob, read during archival

archival_method: Selected exact report fields, actual submission snapshots and immutable-byte manifests; no rerun or reassignment of provenance
omissions: Full controller calls, worker/public-port observation and tool-definition/call arrays are retained in the hashed raw case/report.json files, not copied here.
Full final-state.json, materialized workspace files and operation journals are omitted; exact hashes and relevant submission/adoption/issue facts are retained.
Development reports are separately indexed in v09-development.json and are not relabeled as the frozen final run.
truth_origin: Literal hand-specified finite fixture expectations, also declared in templates.reconciliation.literal_truth; no worker matcher or evaluator call used to construct this archival table.
